authority.semanticOwner: Framework product contract and App domain owners

steps.title: Review complete spatial design
steps.purpose: Task 1: review every owner, handoff, failure path and C01-C12 preservation obligation without production edits.
inputs: Plan scope and current public APIs
conditions: No production writes or borrowed runtime evidence.
bypasses: No bypass: implementation requires accepted design.
allowedContributors: Current source, public contracts and user-approved ownership corrections
forbiddenContributors: Production implementation, new dependencies, fabricated runtime acceptance

steps.title: Resolve independent profile and defaults
steps.purpose: Resolve existing defaults unchanged, reject unsupported official 3D combinations before mutation, install explicit optional definitions through Core.
inputs: Optional 3D-only neutral lighting and software-shadow settings
conditions: 3D supports [] or explicit INPUT only; omitted defaults resolve all then reject INVALID_OPTIONS.
2D/CUSTOM resolution unchanged; provider conflicts rejected before install.
Optional spatial definitions use ordinary pre-start Core registration with atomic cleanup; no new selectable catalog IDs.
Validate, detach and freeze presentation settings before mutation; reject unknown fields and non-3D use. No callbacks or SDK types.
bypasses: CUSTOM binds no preset provider; empty defaults acquire no catalog modules.
allowedContributors: Core public registration and lifecycle facade
forbiddenContributors: Profile-dependent filtering, app installers, SDK construction

steps.title: Initialize one owned render runtime
steps.purpose: Coordinate deferred provider initialization and settle failed/retired startup before successor activation.
inputs: Host surface dimensions; current lifecycle generation
conditions: Provider stays synchronous; engine initialization may be asynchronous.
No successor before startup settlement and teardown.
Initialization request precedes initialized-surface; only then publish ready-runtime. Errors enter retirement without producing readiness.
bypasses: No spatial startup for nonspatial composition.
allowedContributors: Render lifecycle facade and existing Core reset owner
forbiddenContributors: SDK type tests, asynchronous provider contract, placeholder surface

steps.title: Apply canonical edits and replay
steps.purpose: Use existing Core API orchestration into Scene Tree, Props and Factory; preserve their separate state/journal ownership.
inputs: Accepted App mutation or validated load/replay/shared input
conditions: Finite mutation validates before one transaction; state-apply does not re-execute Feature decisions.
Factory owns rollback/history; Scene Tree owns membership; Props owns values.
bypasses: Presentation-only intention makes no canonical write.
allowedContributors: Existing public canonical APIs and App revision/domain validators
forbiddenContributors: New state store, history implementation, transaction across asset decoding

steps.title: Project existing App source semantics
steps.purpose: Consume current canonical App owners to produce completed source shapes and poses without migrating domain algorithms.
inputs: Current canonical source revision and App-owned source assets
conditions: Preserve original geometry and App kinematics; tree-panel visibility does not change canonical granularity.
bypasses: Camera or UI-only changes reuse completed source outputs.
allowedContributors: Existing App geometry/pose producers as read-only authorities
forbiddenContributors: Editing robot/crop/office algorithms, renderer-generated model truth

steps.title: Admit neutral immutable spatial data
steps.purpose: Validate captured descriptors, shapes, surfaces and stable instances once per untrusted input lifetime.
inputs: Untrusted numeric descriptors; App-specific stricter validation
conditions: Detached immutable receipts only; stable instance IDs; world pose applied once; preserve spatialV0 saved identity.
bypasses: Only exact owner-admitted immutable values bypass repeat scans.
allowedContributors: Pure neutral engine types and App input admission
forbiddenContributors: SDK imports, caller freezing as proof, fallback geometry, broadened Sim admission

steps.title: Reconcile spatial output and bounds
steps.purpose: Retain stable derived visual identity, valid submission ordering and correct instance-aware bounds without a second editable graph.
inputs: Explicit pose target, current pose, progress and App tolerance/reduced-motion policy
conditions: Validate full submissions before replacing pending values; scene/camera order preserved.
Camera-only work does not resend meshes; current instance transforms affect bounds.
Pose presentation owns at most one target; no clock, canonical writes or geometry generation.
bypasses: Unchanged descriptors skip updates; empty scene removes output and has null bounds.
allowedContributors: Public Render containers/meshes and registration facade
forbiddenContributors: Domain geometry regeneration, label-based identity, per-instance vertex expansion
cacheDimensions: Existing immutable local shape bounds: exact owner-admitted shape identity; current transforms never cached as local bounds.

cacheEvidence.scope: Preserve current FieldScope immutable bounds preparation during extraction; no new retention family.
cacheEvidence.requiredProof: C05 work-count and output equivalence after current pose/instance changes and retirement.

steps.title: Compute App-directed camera presentation
steps.purpose: Return camera changes from explicit values/deltas/bounds and consume one current transition/follow target.
inputs: App mode/angle/target/limits, explicit time or normalized interpolation progress, logical viewport and current target pose
conditions: Single perspective camera; App controls all mode/policy choices; no target queue.
bypasses: Empty fit preserves camera; reduced motion settles immediately; cancel retires transition.
allowedContributors: App Features and pure camera/bounds contracts
forbiddenContributors: Task reads per frame, document writes, mode selection by App name, independent draw loop

steps.title: Schedule and map abstract spatial commands
steps.purpose: Map registered visual/entity/instance identities and project layers through the abstract engine boundary.
inputs: Current frame invalidation and registered projection targets
conditions: One-shot scheduling; only explicit flush draws; identity mapping separate from display labels.
bypasses: No dirty output means no new draw request.
allowedContributors: Abstract engine contract and registered render layers
forbiddenContributors: Three.js imports, domain policy, duplicate permanent frame loop

steps.title: Execute concrete spatial resources
steps.purpose: Own deferred SDK initialization, geometry/material/light resources, current instance detail and concrete queries.
inputs: Abstract commands, App light/detail policy, surface parameters
Admitted neutral lighting and software-shadow settings captured by the synchronous provider
conditions: No draw from requestFrame; explicit shadow flags independent of selection; actual detail inputs include viewport/DPR.
Full admitted shape owns selectable-instance picking independent of LoD slots.
bypasses: No geometry replacement on pose/material-only update; hidden objects not drawn.
allowedContributors: Three.js confined to this boundary; pure descriptors
forbiddenContributors: Canonical writes, collision verdicts, full glTF claim, invented geometry
cacheDimensions: Existing instance detail: admitted instances, full/distant geometry, maxError, pixelError, world transform, view matrix, projection matrix, viewport height and DPR; retain only while every actual input matches.

cacheEvidence.scope: Preserve existing retained instance-detail product; no new cache family.
cacheEvidence.requiredProof: C08 unchanged reuse and invalidation on every actual dependency, including DPR, visibility, geometry and instance replacement; no performance pass claimed in Task 1.

steps.title: Expose typed spatial queries
steps.purpose: Resolve public visual identities into opaque handles and return typed world/screen/local results through Core.
conditions: Spatial bounds distinct from old 2D queries; foreign/retired IDs reject; no hit is explicit empty.
A query request precedes its result; the request never requires a previous hit result.
bypasses: Outside surface has no ray/hit; unsupported capability rejects before engine work.
allowedContributors: Public Core facade and abstract engine query results
forbiddenContributors: Generic unchecked command escape hatch, SDK runtime extraction, double DOM conversion

steps.title: Route App intent through Features
steps.purpose: Coordinate App-selected actions, selection and cancellation using existing Feature sessions.
inputs: Normalized pointer/modifiers or explicit App command; App action policy
conditions: App decides action/selection/camera mode; capture loss follows declared cancellation; existing selection channels.
bypasses: Programmatic commands bypass hit queries, not Feature intent execution.
allowedContributors: Existing Feature/Input/Selection public APIs
forbiddenContributors: Second session runtime, automatic 2D overlay, persisted camera transit

steps.title: Preview and commit generic transform edits
steps.purpose: Derive deterministic transform previews and delegate one accepted edit to App/Core APIs.
inputs: Authorized target IDs, current revision, axes/plane/grid and App constraints
App-authored absolute draft pose; target authorization and acceptance remain App-owned.
conditions: Preview remains transient; commit revalidates revision; one finite transaction; rigid targets reject scale.
bypasses: Cancel discards preview; no-op creates no history; invalid placement rejects.
allowedContributors: App validator and existing Feature transaction/session APIs
forbiddenContributors: Room validity in Preset, second history stack, writes during incomplete preview

steps.title: Decode restricted detached asset input
steps.purpose: Decode only the existing restricted GLB subset and return immutable source-identified meshes.
inputs: Supplied bytes, cancellation/lifetime and source request identity
Pure neutral spatial contract and restricted format limits; no pre-existing decoded receipt
conditions: Preserve restricted-glb-v0 limits and meanings; no canonical transaction during decode.
bypasses: Absent asset uses no decoder; cancellation/stale result is discarded before App acceptance.
allowedContributors: Existing restricted decoder and App source/archive acceptance
forbiddenContributors: Network fetches, broader format support, canonical writes, storage policy

steps.title: Retire the owning runtime
steps.purpose: Coordinate admission closure, cancellation/settlement and reverse owner cleanup without restarting a retired runtime.
inputs: Dispose/reset or failed-start request for exact generation
conditions: Await existing lifecycle settlement; release every acquired resource; report cleanup errors.
Partial startup cleanup does not require a ready-runtime artifact; initialization failure remains the startup owner error.
bypasses: Repeated retirement is idempotent; completed cleanup is not repeated.
allowedContributors: Existing Core lifecycle, Render teardown and Preset registered cleanup
forbiddenContributors: Timeout as settlement, swallowed cleanup failure, old callback entering successor

steps.title: Preserve FieldScope through migration
steps.purpose: Migrate shared mechanisms while preserving canonical configuration/source/update boundaries.
inputs: Integrated shared foundation and unchanged domain outputs
conditions: Only adapter/control/projection changes; domain geometry and simulations remain authoritative.
bypasses: No bypass: affected unit/profile and real-WebGL cases required.
allowedContributors: Existing App supervisors and formal source oracles
forbiddenContributors: Crop/robot algorithm changes, UI-only performance proof

steps.title: Preserve Sim through migration
steps.purpose: Migrate shared mechanisms without widening strict input or changing original geometry/evidence meaning.
inputs: Integrated shared foundation and strict App source/admission
conditions: Preserve source topology, rigid poses, lighting and analysis/playback boundaries.
bypasses: No bypass: affected source, runtime and real-WebGL cases required.
allowedContributors: Existing App tests and supervisors
forbiddenContributors: Solver modifications, visual hits as physical proof, silent admission widening

steps.title: Preserve Office through migration
steps.purpose: Use shared scene/control mechanisms without changing task, movement, layout or persistence semantics.
inputs: Integrated shared foundation and existing layout/activity projection
App-configured local origin shared by server and browser verification
conditions: App still chooses camera mode/angle and movement destinations; canonical edits separated from transient pose.
Browser evidence uses the same configured App origin; build does not require a local server origin.
Ordinary Office startup uses the official 3D profile with unchanged App-owned light values; explicitly injected custom providers retain CUSTOM.
bypasses: No bypass: layout/Undo/save/stale-proposal and real-WebGL cases required.
allowedContributors: Existing App schema, layout validator, semantic activity projection
forbiddenContributors: Task decisions in Preset, new rewards/floor-building product scope

steps.title: Enable production 3D profile
steps.purpose: Activate only after production foundation and three consumer preservation gates pass.
inputs: Same-source foundation, lifecycle and App preservation evidence
conditions: C01-C08 C11-C12 complete; profile/default independence preserved; no placeholder provider.
bypasses: Unmet prerequisites keep 3D unavailable; HYBRID always remains unavailable here.
allowedContributors: Reviewed provider capability declaration and actual App evidence
forbiddenContributors: Catalog flag as proof, dependency/profile filtering, fake WebGL evidence

steps.title: Review integrated outcome
steps.purpose: Verify all required owners, App preservation, generic extensions and same-source integrated acceptance.
inputs: Actual source-bound implementation evidence and bounded final diff
conditions: Task 9 edits/assets and full integration required in addition to activation.
bypasses: No bypass for missing, stale or failed required evidence.
allowedContributors: Existing plan closeout workflow and actual tests/visual evidence
forbiddenContributors: Claiming design admission is runtime success, publishing or merging without authorization

steps.title: Preserve browser activity delivery
steps.purpose: Publish acknowledged read-only activity updates through the existing default microtask scheduler.
inputs: Validated activity batches, archive acknowledgement and default microtask scheduler
conditions: Preserve archive acknowledgement, coalescing, per-agent notification and injected scheduler behavior. Native callbacks receive a valid invocation receiver.
bypasses: Closed or replayed inputs retain existing no-notification behavior.
allowedContributors: ActivityProjection and the native microtask scheduler
forbiddenContributors: App-specific workaround, task decisions, canonical writes, new clocks or swallowed errors
